// CASE js_block_const_then_param_call expect=pass
export async function a(items, width) {
  if (items.length === 0) {
    const width = 1;
    log(width);
  }
  await mapLimit(items, width, save);
}
// CASE js_for_of_simple_shadow expect=pass
export async function b(groups, widths) {
  const width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  await Promise.all(widths.map(async () => {
    for (const width of widths) {
      await mapLimit(groups, width, save);
      break;
    }
  }));
}
// CASE js_for_let_header_shadow expect=pass
export async function c(items) {
  const width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  for (let width = 2; width <= 8; width *= 2) {
    await mapLimit(items, width, save);
    break;
  }
}
// CASE js_destructure_with_default_body expect=pass
const width4 = 1;
export async function d(items, config) {
  const { width4 = 8 } = config;
  await mapLimit(items, width4, save);
}
// CASE js_object_method_destructured_param expect=pass
const limit = 1;
export const importer = {
  async run({ items, limit }) {
    await mapLimit(items, limit, save);
  },
};
// CASE js_class_method_destructured_param expect=pass
const concurrency = 1;
export class Exporter {
  async run({ items, concurrency }) {
    await mapLimit(items, save, { concurrency });
  }
}
// CASE end expect=pass
